FM05.reasoning: The dataset is a time series (traffic volume over time), but the agent uses a randomized K-Fold split which ignores temporal order and introduces look-ahead bias by allowing future data into the training set.

other_failure_modes.name: Overwriting test IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent overwrites the test set's identifier column with a new sequential range. If the evaluation system uses the original 'id' column to join the submission with the ground truth, this will cause a complete mismatch and evaluation failure.

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect submission file path
other_failure_modes.description: The agent saves the submission file to a newly created subdirectory instead of the root working directory, which often causes the automated evaluation harness to fail to locate the file (as seen in the execution log).

summary: The agent built a strong pipeline with excellent leak-free feature engineering, out-of-fold target encoding, and sophisticated ensembling. However, it fundamentally failed by using randomized cross-validation on a time-series dataset (FM05), causing temporal leakage. Additionally, the agent likely triggered the execution failure observed in the logs by overwriting test set IDs and saving the submission file to a non-standard subdirectory path.
